chunks: A time is fixed for every prophecy; you will come to know in time.

key_terms.مُسْتَقَرٌّ: A fixed place, time, or destination

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by 'a time is fixed for every prophecy'?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the concept of *istiqrar* (settling point), affirming that every prophetic claim has a definitive moment of verification, a principle often linked to the eventual manifestation of Imam Mahdi. It serves as a divine reassurance to the Prophet Muhammad and the believers that the truth of the message will become clear and manifest to all at the appointed time. This certainty reinforces the Shia belief in the ultimate vindication of the Ahl al-Bayt and the fulfillment of divine promises despite contemporary opposition.
